provenance: Reviewed problem-type policies, not extracted contract clauses or invoice-label exceptions.
reference_policy: Exclude all original target invoice IDs and duplicate IDs. Also exclude the historical invoice itself when inferring a history line.
variant_policy: Prefer original-wording groups (case, punctuation and opaque suffix normalised). Do not merge abbreviations or word order at this level. Use broader token-equivalent groups only if their evidence is consistent and does not conflict with available exact-variant evidence.
family_assumption: Recognised service-family words are truthful. Contradictory modifiers may mean a different or uncontracted service. A family restricts historical effects only; it never confirms a service identity.
confidence_policy: No numeric confidence is calibrated. All price-derived identity and history assumptions remain conditional; the two-reference policy is explicitly lower assurance.
